node.doctext: Hello [manchali] and welcome to the Monastery. Could you provide a small sample that shows what you are trying to do? That is: small input file(s), the expected output for that input, and any code you've tried so far? See also [id://1177642] and [id://174051] for more details on what would help us help you better.
